title: Privacy rules went further than the law; bring every rule, check and page copy back to the legal line
problem: The usage rules banned cookies outright, made counting opt-in, forbade storing even the kind of referring site, and banned any analytics vendor. The law (GDPR, ePrivacy/PECR, CCPA) requires none of that for functional cookies or anonymous aggregate counts. The extra restrictions cost the portfolio its measurement: live_url_visitors is null on every reading, and distribution (the stated limiter) cannot be judged without knowing where visitors come from. The owner, 2026-10-20: 'follow laws but going beyond them is too much.'
evidence: portfolio/usage/README.md rule 1 before 2026-10-20: 'No accounts, no cookies, no IP storage, no device fingerprints, no cross-site identifiers, no content.'
platform/counter/counter.mjs before 2026-10-20: 'no referrer' stored, so no reading could say which kind of site sends visitors.
portfolio/usage/validate_usage.py FORBIDDEN_SIGNAL_TOKENS included 'cookie', so even a count named like cookie_banner_dismissed failed validation.
change: Done in the first PR: owner direction recorded in prompts/goals.md; usage README rules, PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK privacy and usage sections, AGENTS.md and DIRECTION.md rewritten to 'follow the law, no stricter'; 'cookie' dropped from the validator's forbidden tokens; the counter records the referring-site class (src:<class>, closed list, reduced in the browser, so no host is sent) with tests and matching site copy. Still to do: (1) deploy platform/counter so the default-on count actually runs (needs one always-on HTTPS host; the owner has to provide or approve the machine); (2) a small shared consent helper (EU/UK prior consent, a disclosure elsewhere) so a product can use an identifier for returning-visitor counts or A/B tests when it needs to; (3) sweep remaining code comments and tests that state the old rule as a reason (grep 'never people', 'no analytics vendor', 'No cookies') and update those that now block a legal feature; descriptive copy that is still true can stay.
metric: readings in portfolio/usage/site-visits.json with page_loads > 0 and at least one src:<class> key
baseline: 0: site-visits.json does not exist yet and platform/counter/site.json has an empty url (2026-10-20)
